stages.name: Pike foundation
stages.work: Pike push-ups, feet on floor → feet elevated; wrist prep; scapular shrugs; hollow hold
ready: 3 × 10 feet-elevated pike push-ups, hips over hands

exercises.name: Wrist extension rocks
exercises.cue: Kneeling, palms down, rock forward and back. Warm the wrists before pressing.

exercises.name: Pike push-up (feet on floor)
exercises.cue: Hips high over the hands; the head travels forward between the hands. Move the feet to a low box once 3 × 10 is clean.

exercises.name: Pike scapular shrugs
exercises.cue: Arms locked. Push the floor away and shrug the shoulders to the ears.

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.cue: Lower back flat, ribs tucked toward the pelvis.

stages.name: Wall handstand
stages.work: Chest-to-wall walk-ups and holds, line and breathing

exercises.name: Wrist extension rocks
exercises.cue: Kneeling, palms down, rock forward and back. Warm the wrists before pressing.

exercises.name: Chest-to-wall walk-up
exercises.cue: Feet up the wall first, then walk the hands in until your chest is close to the wall.
exercises.note: Walk back down with control. If you cannot hold the top for a few seconds, stay lower on the wall.

exercises.name: Chest-to-wall hold
exercises.cue: Push tall through the shoulders, ribs in, glutes tight. Breathe slowly through the nose.
exercises.note: Add a few seconds each session. End the set when your back starts to arch. 3 × 45 s is the standard.

exercises.name: Feet-elevated pike push-up
exercises.cue: Feet on a bench, hips over the hands, head travels forward between the hands.
exercises.note: Keeps your pressing strength up while the wall work takes over.

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.cue: Lower back flat, ribs tucked toward the pelvis. The handstand line starts here.

stages.name: Negatives
stages.work: Wall HSPU negatives, 5 s lowering to a head-touch on a folded mat

exercises.name: Wrist extension rocks
exercises.cue: Kneeling, palms down, rock forward and back. Warm the wrists before pressing.

exercises.name: Chest-to-wall hold
exercises.cue: Same tall line as before. This is your warm-up for the negatives.

exercises.name: Wall handstand push-up negative
exercises.cue: Elbows tucked, lower in a straight line until your head touches a folded mat. Then step down and walk back up.
exercises.note: Start at 3 s down and add a second once every rep is smooth. If you drop instead of lowering, stop the set. Do not try to press back up yet.

exercises.name: Feet-elevated pike push-up
exercises.cue: Feet on a bench, hips over the hands, head travels forward between the hands.
exercises.note: Keeps your pressing strength up while the wall work takes over.

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.cue: Lower back flat, ribs tucked toward the pelvis.

stages.name: Partial range
stages.work: Wall HSPU to a mat stack, depth increasing as the stack shrinks (15 → 10 → 5 cm)

exercises.name: Wrist extension rocks
exercises.cue: Kneeling, palms down, rock forward and back. Warm the wrists before pressing.

exercises.name: Chest-to-wall hold
exercises.cue: Tall line, ribs in. A short warm-up before pressing.

exercises.name: Wall handstand push-up to a mat stack
exercises.cue: Elbows tucked, head touches the stack, press all the way to straight arms.
exercises.note: Start with the stack at about 15 cm. Lower it to 10 cm, then to about 5 cm, once every set reaches 6 clean reps. End the set when the press slows a lot or your back arches.

exercises.name: Feet-elevated pike push-up
exercises.cue: Feet on a bench, hips over the hands, head travels forward between the hands.
exercises.note: Keeps your pressing strength up while the wall work takes over.

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.cue: Lower back flat, ribs tucked toward the pelvis.

stages.name: Full range
stages.work: Wall HSPU, head to the floor, no mat

exercises.name: Wrist extension rocks
exercises.cue: Kneeling, palms down, rock forward and back. Warm the wrists before pressing.

exercises.name: Full-range negative
exercises.cue: Elbows tucked, lower slowly until your head touches the floor, then step down.
exercises.note: This is the warm-up. Keep it smooth and stop before it gets shaky.

exercises.name: Full-range wall handstand push-up
exercises.cue: Head to the floor, press to straight arms, no kicking.
exercises.note: Add a rep when both sets are clean. Stop a set the moment form slips.

exercises.name: Strict test: 5 in a row
exercises.cue: Head to the floor, arms fully straight at the top, no kick.
exercises.note: Stop the set at the first rep that breaks form, then rest in full. 5 clean reps in a row is the goal. Skip the attempts on a day your shoulders or wrists feel off.

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.cue: Lower back flat, ribs tucked toward the pelvis.

stages.name: Beyond the goal
stages.note: Outside the goal; only if you want it later

exercises.name: Wrist extension rocks
exercises.cue: Kneeling, palms down, rock forward and back. Warm the wrists before pressing.

exercises.name: Deficit wall handstand push-up
exercises.cue: Hands on two sturdy blocks or parallettes, head dips below hand height, press to straight arms.
exercises.note: Start with a small deficit and add height only after 5 clean reps. Stop if your shoulders or wrists complain.

exercises.name: Freestanding handstand kick-up
exercises.cue: Kick up away from the wall, stack the wrists, hips and ankles, and look between your hands.
exercises.note: Learn how to bail out first: step down one foot or cartwheel out. Keep it on a mat and stop when your line gets sloppy.

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.cue: Lower back flat, ribs tucked toward the pelvis.
